cases.name: Stephanie Gill
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Stephanie worked in retail and loved to shop. She was known for her funny, vibrant, charismatic, beautiful, and bold personality. All who knew her were blessed to experience the joy and happiness she possessed."
cases.narrative: He shot and killed her outside Smyrna Middle School. Police said Gill and Lew had gone to the school to pick up their daughter for a doctor's appointment. The two got into a verbal argument outside the car, and Lew pulled out a gun and shot his wife.
